# Rank Math
- Title (54): "Snowbird Home Plumbing Checklist: Reopening an AZ Home". Meta 151 characters.
- Schema: BlogPosting plus FAQPage. The draft lists the author as a named person (Ty Lemieux); note that the project rule is author "Summit Plumbing Pros", so check what is live.

# Content
- Quick answer: inspect before you pressurize. Read the meter with the shutoff closed, check cabinets, floors, water heater and hoses, open the main slowly, flush cold then hot lines, refill drain traps.
- Cites the CDC on Legionella growth in stagnant warm water.
